PG2: NAFTA has increased overall welfare. We've seen the gains; this guy is lying.

Pg11-12: His description of comparative advantage is good. Except he neglects the reason you would stay in Iceland; the opportunity cost of moving fishing business to Guatemala (forgone banana production) would make it reasonable to stay in Iceland.

Pg 15-16: Trade doesn't destroy jobs; read the studies I linked above. I love lump of labor fallacy.

Pg19: Everybody is taking home around the same portion of the national income; it's just not coming in money income.

Pg23: Glass-Steagall didn't do shit to cause the Financial crisis. Glass-Steagall was rendered ineffective by 1974; allowing de facto investment and commercial bank combos. None of the banks that failed in 2008 were investment/commercial banks.

I came up with the idea for AWFW while feeling very lonely at VU. Not a lot of people admit to being from welfare and at VU, there's not a lot period. So here I was, wanting more people like me to be at college. But unlike me, some may not have the best grades to even go to college. A lot of people give up when they realize that they most likely won't be able to afford to go.

I came up with an idea. I want to give society hope. I want to get rid of the stigma of "welfare". I want to help. So I asked a bunch of people what to do to start a nonprofit. I was sent all around Porter County to ask a billion questions before I just googled my answer. I went to the law clinic to get reassurance that I was doing it all correctly. He was very intrigued by what I was doing and assigned me a lawyer.

I got together a board of students whom I had met who were broke like me. Who had no money, hope, or want to be in college anymore. They are now my board of directors. We have hosted several fundraisers. We are currently featured at drunkcharity.org, nexercise, get involved be the change, and the last one I am still working on.

We gave out a check to a girl named Natalie on March 25th. She was so moved she and her family began to cry. We didn't get much publicity, but I didn't care. In that moment, it was all about that girl and the fact that she could now have the ability to not live on welfare for the rest of her life.

That is the cliff notes of A Will for Welfare. My name is August Hatter. I plan to change the world.
